title: CondoGuard Unit Rental Endorsement: Form Provisions and Signing
content:
The unit rental endorsement of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy is the named insured's own declaration that the condominium unit is rented to others, signed on the named insured's CondoGuard policy.

## Conditions of the endorsement

1. A unit rental endorsement takes effect on the day the named insured requests it, and that day is before the expiration date.
2. A unit rental endorsement is not recorded until the declarations carry the higher of the tier's two personal liability limits.

Put the other way round, the second condition means that while the declarations carry the lower of the tier's two personal liability limits, no unit rental endorsement is recorded on the policy.

## What signing records

Signing records the unit rental endorsement, with its full-year premium effect and the premium charged for the rest of the term, marked as additional premium. It changes the occupancy shown on the declarations to rented to others and posts the charge as an additional-premium entry on the policy's premium account, raising the amount owed by that charge. On success the declarations show the unit as rented to others with the rental endorsement in force, effective the day of signing.

## Signing: the tool

`add_unit_rental_endorsement_60a857ee` is the named insured's own tool. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to sign the endorsement (`call_user_discoverable_tool`).

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `condo_policy_id` | the reference number of the insured's own CondoGuard policy, as the service representative reads it out from the policy record | reference number, text |
| `annual_premium_change` | the full-year premium of the unit rental endorsement, as the representative quotes it | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount, rounded half-up to the cent when stored |
| `prorated_premium` | the premium charged for the rest of the current term, as the representative quotes it | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount, rounded half-up to the cent when stored and posted as the additional-premium charge |

## Receipt

On success the tool returns `status` `rental_endorsement_added`, with `endorsement_id` (reference number of the new endorsement entry), `billing_id` (reference number of the additional-premium entry), `condo_policy_id` (the policy endorsed), `occupancy` `rented_to_others` (the occupancy now on the declarations), `effective_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `prorated_premium` (the charge posted, USD).
